PR description:
- Do retries GET requests that get a 502, 503 or 504, up to MaxRetries times, doubling the delay each time.

- Never retries a non-idempotent method: a POST is sent exactly once.

+package client
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// Do sends req, retrying transient gateway errors with exponential backoff.
+func (c *Client) Do(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
+	delay := c.BaseDelay
+	for attempt := 0; ; attempt++ {
+		resp, err := c.HTTP.Do(req)
+		if err != nil || !transient(resp.StatusCode) || attempt == c.MaxRetries {
+			return resp, err
+		}
+		resp.Body.Close()
+		time.Sleep(delay)
+		delay *= 2
+	}
+}
+
+func transient(code int) bool {
+	return code == 502 || code == 503 || code == 504
+}

+		codes = codes[1:]

+	defer srv.Close()
+	c := &Client{HTTP: srv.Client(), MaxRetries: 3}
+	req, _ := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, srv.URL, nil)
